*   The 'ls_integration' field must not override an existing value if one is already set in the metadata — it should only be added when not already present.

*   The 'ls_integration' metadata must propagate through all graph execution event types including stream mode message events, run callbacks, subgraph executions, and exception/error event paths.

The verification system will apply test patches automatically.

## What I did

The `'ls_integration': 'langgraph'` marker is injected at a single, well-chosen chokepoint and propagates everywhere via LangGraph's existing config-merging machinery.

## Why this covers every requirement

`stream`/`astream` are the single execution funnel — `invoke`/`ainvoke`, the functional API, and subgraph runs all route through them. Injecting into the root run metadata there means:

- **Message events, subgraphs, error paths**: `StreamMessagesHandler` reads node config metadata; subgraphs re-enter `stream`/`astream` (re-applying `setdefault`); error/exception paths use the same metadata object.
